title: images
description: Image generation, editing and media-job settings (docs/design/CONFIG_HOMES.md, C8a). The storage roots and the URL signing secret are startup settings.

signed_url_ttl.description: Seconds a signed image URL stays valid.

vram_reserve_bytes.description: Free VRAM, in bytes, kept as a safety margin when the batch size is computed.

free_vram_on_exhaustion.description: Unload idle models once when admission or an out-of-memory error shows the current residency blocks the workflow.

max_batch_size.description: Hard ceiling on the images made in one engine prompt, whatever the VRAM headroom.

background_removal.description: The transparent, opaque or auto background option.

enabled.description: Whether the background option is served.

decision_timeout.description: Seconds the automatic (auto) decision may take.

variations.description: How /v1/images/variations runs: through an edit-capable workflow with a fixed prompt.

default_workflow.description: The edit-capable workflow id a variations request runs.

denoise.description: Partial-denoise strength, used only when the workflow declares a denoise input.

default_workflow.description: The workflow id for an image edit that names no model, unless model_compatibility.defaults.image_edits overrides it.

multiref_default_workflow.description: The workflow id for a multi-image edit that otherwise resolves to the default edit workflow.

media_jobs.description: Durable image, audio and make jobs.

max_attempts.description: Attempts a job gets before it fails for good.

retry_base_seconds.description: First retry delay in seconds; each retry doubles it.

resume_on_start.description: Whether the jobs that were running at shutdown resume at start. Read at start.

concurrency.description: Jobs that run at once. The limit is sized at start.

make.description: Limits of the session make jobs (/me/api/make/jobs).

max_outstanding_per_person.description: Queued or running make jobs one person may hold.

max_outstanding.description: Queued or running make jobs in all.

graph_roles.description: Graph facts the ComfyUI input maps cannot carry. Keys exactly name manifest workflow paths; entries replace whole.

slot.description: The transparent IMAGE output used by the shipped RMBG graphs.
